source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Inequalities with a parameter are solved case by case: ax > 1 gives x > 1/a for a > 0, x < 1/a for a < 0 and nothing for a = 0.
stages.headlineEnglish: Inequalities with a parameter are solved case by case: ax > 1 gives x > 1/a for a > 0, x < 1/a for a < 0 and nothing for a = 0.

stages.headline: x² + bx + c > 0 for every x exactly when D < 0 (with a positive leading coefficient).
stages.headlineEnglish: x² + bx + c > 0 for every x exactly when D < 0 (with a positive leading coefficient).

stages.headline: Example: x² − 2ax + 4 > 0 for every x when D = 4a² − 16 < 0, i.e. −2 < a < 2.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: x² − 2ax + 4 > 0 for every x when D = 4a² − 16 < 0, i.e. −2 < a < 2.
